liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Reviewer is hooked on a passage starting around the 9:30 mark of this Terrapin version; Includes a section of Terrapin that reviewer says appears only on the studio album [5][6][7]
- **Passenger** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the funky studio take of this song interesting; Reviewer hears early, different versions of Passenger and Fire on the Mountain [2][8]
- **Equinox** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the first live Equinox they have heard [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Equinox**: rare: 4 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **gd77-02-20.sbd.moreno.9470.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 55 min; rated 3.97/5 by 29 [1]

## Around the show

- The recording is a set of studio outtakes from the Terrapin Station sessions, not a concert [1]
- Same outtakes as the 2/17/77 Terrapin/Mars release, which additionally has three Mars outtakes including Unbroken, Cucamonga and Money, Money [4]
- Points to 3/18/77 as the only live performance of Terrapin as presented in this studio version [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-02-20.sbd.moreno.9470.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard source passed through an unknown generation to CDR, then seeded to etree by Paul Moreno [1]
